title: D2P Pattern
description: Content of one immutable revision of a pattern artifact (artifactType d2p:pattern; design decisions ADR-006, ADR-007, ADR-007.1). Parametrics (parameters, measurement inputs, features) are the source of truth; geometry is derived. All arrays keep authoring order, so reordering elements changes the content digest. Element IDs share one namespace per document.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against ("1.0.0" in this release).

artifactId.description: ID of the pattern artifact this content belongs to.

revisionId.description: ID of the immutable artifact revision whose content this document is.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (digest profile d2p-digest-v1, computed with this member excluded).

featureSetVersion.description: Version of the d2p: feature types and expression nodes used ("1.0.0" in this release).

definitionRegistries.description: Measurement-definition registries (ID and version) used by the measurement inputs. May be empty.

measurementInputs.description: Measurement inputs bound to measurement definitions. May be empty.

seamConnections.description: Binary seam connections. May be empty.

featureCapabilities.description: Exactly one capability per extension feature type used (D2P-SEM-005). It MUST NOT list d2p: feature types (schema-enforced). May be empty.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

parameter.title: Parameter
parameter.description: A named, dimensioned value defined by an expression. The expression MUST evaluate to the declared dimension (D2P-SEM-002).

id.description: Stable element ID of the parameter.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

measurementInput.title: Measurement input
measurementInput.description: Binds a key used in expressions to a measurement definition. Values are resolved per evaluation request.

key.description: Key referenced by measurement expression nodes; unique among the pattern's measurement inputs.

definitionId.description: Measurement definition ID, resolved in the registries named by 'definitionRegistries' (D2P-REF-008).

required.description: Whether an evaluation needs a value for this input (D2P-SEM-072 when none resolves and there is no fallback).

fallback.description: Optional estimate used when no value resolves. Using it emits D2P-EVL-011. Its unit MUST match the definition's dimension (D2P-SEM-070).
